component.name: Kollate
component.summary: Collect and curate highlights and vocabulary from your Kobo

description.p: Plug in your Kobo e-reader and Kollate brings in your highlights, notes, handwritten markups and Vocabulary Builder words, without ever changing anything on the device and without duplicates.

ul.li: Triage new highlights in an inbox, star, tag, edit and archive them
See the sentence each vocabulary word appeared in, with an offline definition
Sync notes to an Obsidian vault and export Anki decks, JSON, CSV or Readwise CSV

description.p: Vocabulary definitions now come from the English Wiktionary (over 800,000 words, compiled by reader.dict) instead of WordNet. Words you've looked up are re-defined automatically, and definitions you wrote yourself are kept. Dictionaries for other languages can be added in DictFile format, and Preferences links to where to get them.
Kollate now refuses to save anything onto your Kobo, even if you choose it as an export, Obsidian or library location. The e-reader is only ever read.
Highlights deleted on the Kobo are now easier to track:

ul.li: The import summary reports highlights deleted on (and restored to) the Kobo
A Deleted on Kobo view lists them
A new preference can move them to Trash automatically

description.p: A new Books page shows your library as covers, sorted by most recent; the sidebar keeps your five latest books, and books with nothing left to show are hidden.

Search is now always visible, starring a highlight in the Inbox also keeps it, and you can select several highlights to keep, archive, star or trash them at once, or keep the whole Inbox. A new Keyboard Shortcuts window (Ctrl+?) lists every shortcut.
First release: import, curation, vocabulary enrichment and export.
